subject: MAP: Close acceleration plan, evaluation gating & risk syndication
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@nimbusanalytics.com>, procurement@nimbusanalytics.com
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 9 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP: Close acceleration plan, evaluation gating & risk syndication

Sam / Nimbus procurement team —

Quick summary: the internal MAP we reviewed last week shows a risk of a 3–4 week slip in the formal close if we keep the current sequential evaluation -> procurement -> legal flow. I’m proposing a condensed plan to derisk the close while preserving a defensible evaluation gate for Nimbus.

Key proposed changes (attached: MAP_v2.xlsx, Risk_Syndication_Log_20270309.xlsx):
- Parallelize QA evaluation and procurement paperwork: run the production smoke pilot (sandbox access) while procurement completes PO terms. Acceptance gate for pilot: stable latency under 300ms p50, no PII in outputs after sanitizer pass, and a 3-day regression-free run on the eval prompt set.
- Timeboxing legal redlines: legal to produce redline summary within 5 business days; if material new risk is flagged, we use the fallback of a scoped MSA addendum limited to inference SLA and data handling while broader T&Cs are worked.
- Commitment: Redwood provides 40 hours of dedicated onboarding support + a one-month credit buffer if the pilot goes over budget.

Asks:
1) Sam — confirm whether procurement can accept the pilot-first approach (procurement@nimbus) and whether you can commit to a 10-business-day turnaround on the PO once terms are agreed.
2) Laura / Marissa — please confirm we can dedicate the 40 PS hours and confirm SLA language we’ll offer for the pilot addendum.
3) Aditya — please prepare a short runbook for the sandbox and a minimal eval checklist we can use as the acceptance gate.

If we can get sign-off on these items by EOD Thursday (Mar 11), we can keep the nominal close in late March. If not, we should plan for an explicit 3-week re-baseline and escalate.

Thanks —
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
T: +1 415-555-0172
[Attachment: MAP_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: Risk_Syndication_Log_20270309.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@nimbusanalytics.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@nimbusanalytics.com
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Close acceleration plan, evaluation gating & risk syndication

Vivek —

Thanks for the concrete plan and the attachments. Short answer: we’re aligned on the pilot-first concept, but there are three blockers on our side that will affect turnaround:

1) Legal redlines: our counsel requires a SOC 2 attestation scope attached or a statement of controls. We can accept a scoped addendum but need evidence.
2) Procurement cycle: because Nimbus is enterprise-funded, procurement routing requires vendor onboarding which is currently queued — estimated 12 business days to assign a buyer and complete PO if docs are clean.
3) Data governance: our security team is insisting on a transient data retention config and a list of encryption options (KMS or HSM).

Mitigations we can do: we can stand up a small production-similar pilot (token-limited) next week if Redwood can provide a temporary SOC 2 cert extract and enable a transient retention policy. Procurement will prioritize if legal confirms the addendum path.

Can you share the SOC 2 extract and a sample addendum? Also, can Redwood commit to a 24-hour escalation contact during the pilot window?

—Sam
Sam Jenkins
Head of Platform Engineering, Nimbus Analytics
sam.jenkins@nimbusanalytics.com
[Quoted text]

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@nimbusanalytics.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Close acceleration plan, evaluation gating & risk syndication

Sam —

Appreciate the quick signal. We can deliver the following ASAP to unblock your security and procurement:

- SOC 2 extract: attaching a redacted SOC 2 summary for the inference controls and a short security brief on our retention config.
- Retention & encryption: we will enable transient retention (24h TTL) for the pilot and support customers using either Cloud KMS or recommended HSM patterns.
- Escalation: I will be the primary 24-hour escalation contact for the pilot window (laura.bennett@redwood.ai, +1 408-555-0123).

Operational asks from Redwood:
- We need procurement to confirm whether an addendum covering inference SLA + data handling is acceptable as a short-term legal instrument. If accepted, our legal team will draft the addendum and aim to turn it in 3 business days.
- PS staffing: Marissa — please confirm the 40 hours and schedule.

If procurement can't meet the 10-business-day target, we should escalate to execs and propose a targeted credit to cover any pilot overrun. I’ll loop Marissa and prepare an escalation template.

Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success — Enterprise, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: escalation_template.docx (document)]

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Sam Jenkins <sam.jenkins@nimbusanalytics.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Mar 2027 16:42:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: Nimbus Analytics close at risk — request for exec intervention

Team — quick executive summary and ask below. Copying Nimbus to keep transparency.

Risk summary:
- Current close (deal NIM-2027-042) at risk of slipping 3–4 weeks due to procurement/vetting queue and legal evidence requests. Severity: P2 (material schedule impact, customer still engaged).
- Root causes: vendor onboarding queue in procurement; customer security needs (SOC 2 evidence) before procurement will prioritize.

What Redwood has done:
- Shared MAP_v2 and risk syndication log; proposed pilot-first approach and a 40-hour PS commitment.
- Laura committed to provide SOC 2 extract and 24h escalation.

Ask of Sales & CS leadership:
1) Exec touch to Nimbus CFO / Head of Procurement to expedite vendor onboarding (ask: reduce procurement routing from estimated 12 biz days to <= 7 biz days).
2) Approve a one-time pilot credit of up to $12,000 if procurement delays force extended pilot runtime. This is budgeted from the deal acceleration fund.
3) If procurement is immovable, approve limited exceptions to standard procurement sequence to accept the addendum + PO path.

Why now: If we secure exec help and accept the addendum path, we can start the token-limited pilot next week and keep target close in late March. Without intervention, plan a 3-week re-baseline and update the forecast.

Next steps I’ll own:
- Laura will send the SOC 2 extract and addendum template today.
- Marissa will confirm PS schedule and standby engineer.
- I will schedule a 15-minute briefing call with Nimbus execs if leadership approves outreach.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
